summary: First Merchants Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Base Indenture and First Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association as trustee, covering $100 million of 6.750% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due October 1, 2036. Interest is semi-annual until October 1, 2031, then Three-Month Term SOFR plus 202 basis points quarterly. The notes are redeemable at par from October 1, 2031, or earlier on tax or regulatory capital events with Federal Reserve approval, and qualify as Tier 2 capital. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation; watch regulatory capital treatment and redemption optionality.
